result.title: CROSS-Calib: Selective Channel Calibration for Ultrasound Reconstruction
result.summary: Ultrasound imaging provides views of internal tissue in real time for medical diagnosis. However, ultrasound signals may be affected by interference, and correcting errors and removing transient interference while preserving valid echoes remains challenging. We propose CROSS-Calib, a channel recovery method that uses predictions from other channels as references for amplitude and phase calibration, while a gate using context selectively combines calibrated measurements with predicted echoes to retain usable samples and repair unreliable ones. On the in vivo test set, CROSS-Calib outperforms all baseline models under gain errors and transient interference, while phantom tests show that the model restores cyst contrast with echo widths of wire targets close to the clean reference. CROSS-Calib can perform channel calibration and selective repair before beamforming to improve echo usability and image quality.

AI.brief_summary: 该论文提出 CROSS-Calib，一种超声通道恢复方法：以其他通道的预测作为幅相校准参考，并用上下文门控选择性地将校准测量与预测回波融合，在波束成形前修复不可靠样本、保留可用样本。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「预测与实测之间的可靠性门控、按样本选择性保留或修补」的机制，可能为 LVR 中视觉证据筛选与何时信任证据而非 latent 先验的问题提供概念类比，但领域与任务相距较远，需核查其门控判据能否迁移。
